outcome: The technician sees each aircraft tail and status.
in_scope: List aircraft for one signed-in technician. Status values are serviceable, in_maintenance, and grounded.
out_of_scope: Editing status, export, and login screens.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/aircraft with token tech-1 returns 200 and each aircraft tail and status.
A signed-in technician with an empty fleet sees the text No aircraft.
A request without a known token returns 403 and the text Forbidden.
error_and_permission_rules: A missing or unknown token returns 403. No other role can list aircraft.
data_rules: In-memory records only. Each aircraft has tail and status. Status is serviceable, in_maintenance, or grounded.
